analysis.title: Old Dominion Freight Line Inc. (ODFL): 3Q26 EPS First Take: Ahead of Forecast; Implied Tons Turn Positive in September
key_insights: ODFL (Buy) reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $1.65 vs $1.61 FactSet consensus and $1.63 GS estimate.
Operating ratio of 71.5% was 30bps ahead of consensus of 71.8% (71.6% GSe) on total revenue of about $1.6B, about 1% above Street and in line with GSe.
LTL tons per day grew -0.1% YoY vs -0.5% GSe. Revenue per hundredweight including fuel grew +13.3% YoY vs +13.7% GSe, and ex-fuel grew +5.1% vs +4.5% GSe.
Expense leverage was slightly better on net, with EBIT about 2% above Street on about 1% higher revenue.

Tons per day at -0.1% implies September tonnage turned positive YoY after a significant period of declines. GS calls it a solid quarter with an encouragingly better volume trendline to finish the quarter.
On the 10am ET call GS expects updates on October revenue trends, sequential margin expectations and the core business environment.
Street/GSe 4Q OR of about 73.7% implies about 220bps of deterioration vs the 3Q26 actual of 71.5%. Historical 3Q-to-4Q OR deterioration averages about 200-250bps per ODFL management commentary.

An in-line seasonal guide would produce a 4Q OR about in line with current consensus and GSe, while a guide slightly better than seasonality would imply a better OR. Given the revenue beat, GS thinks an in-line OR would still lead to raised estimates.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 EPS of $1.65 beat consensus of $1.61 and GSe of $1.63. September tonnage implied positive YoY. The 12-month target uses about 34x Q5-Q8 EPS estimates, with 30.5% upside from $187.03.

earnings_insights: ODFL 3Q26 reported recurring EPS $1.65 vs FactSet consensus $1.61 and GSe $1.63 (printed 10/28/2026).
3Q26 revenue reported $1,591M vs consensus $1,572M (+1.2%) and GSe $1,595M (-0.2%).
3Q26 EBIT reported $453M vs consensus $445M (+1.7%) and GSe $453M.
3Q26 recurring net income reported $344M vs consensus $334M (+3.0%) and GSe $341M.
3Q26 operating ratio reported 71.5% vs consensus 71.8% and GSe 71.6%.
LTL revenue reported $1,576.6M, +13.1% YoY vs GSe +13.4%.
Shipments per day reported 43.3 (-2.0% YoY) vs GSe 43.2 (-2.3%). Weight per shipment 1,486.1 (+1.9% YoY).
Revenue per hundredweight reported $38.40 (+13.3% YoY) vs GSe $38.51 (+13.7%). Ex-fuel surcharge $30.25 (+5.1% YoY) vs GSe $30.08 (+4.5%).
Pre-print Street expectations (estimates): 3Q revenue per day +16% YoY, full-quarter tonnage growth +3% YoY, rev/cwt ex-fuel about +5% YoY, rev/cwt including fuel about +13%.
Salaries, wages and benefits were 44.3% of revenue vs GSe 43.7%. Operating taxes and licenses were 2.1% vs GSe 2.5%.
GS forecasts (estimates): FY26 EPS $5.85, FY27 $6.85, FY28 $7.50, vs FY25 $4.84. Quarterly GSe EPS: 9/26E $1.63, 12/26E $1.46, 3/27E $1.49.
risk_factors: Slower-than-expected recovery in the industrial economy, including tariff concerns.
Inability to extract strong price or yield improvements if the volume outlook softens or competitive price pressure arises.
Faster-than-forecast ramp in operating expenses or headcount that could hurt incremental margin as volumes recover.
The above-historical-average valuation multiple could come under pressure on economic concerns or margin improvement potential.
